title: The super Alternative Daugavet property, unconditional bases and SCD geometry
summary: We answer negatively the 1-unconditional part of Question 6.4, by Langemets, Lõo, Martín, Perreau and Rueda Zoca, and, more generally, prove that no infinite-dimensional Banach space with a $K$-unconditional basis, for $1\leq K 1$, there exists a Banach space with a $k$-unconditional basis whose unit ball is not slicely countably determined, thereby giving a positive answer to Question 5.4.
